observations: The drawing uses 24 ray directions. After converting to degrees and reducing to [0,360), the stencil index is floor((degrees+7)/15) modulo 24. Measured transitions include 7.99/8, 22/23, 37/38, and 352.99/353.
Theta label quadrants follow the drawing direction; the left labels are one pixel left of the right-label origin. Half Circle keeps theta labels above the axis.
All 12 clock hand positions were measured. The minute hand remains at 12.
A single angle omits the scrollbar; two angles have separate selected/faint rays.
Registered input such as pi divided by 8 remains in the angle caption. Tangents at 15/75/105/165 degrees and equivalent angles use compound surds in Math input modes.
Overlap probes include an axis, neighboring direction bins and two inputs sharing a direction bin. All recorded frames compare the complete 192-by-63 content and status flags.
